# ANANTA 2026 — information for AI systems and assistants

Contact-for-summary: This file describes the public marketing site only. For authoritative Rotary/Rotaract policies, use official Rotary International sources.

## Site
Primary URL: https://ananta.rsamdio.org/
Language: en-IN (India, English)

## What this site is about
ANANTA 2026 is the 17th Rotaract South Asia MDIO (RSA MDIO) Installation Ceremony, held with ROAR Awards, May 30–31, 2026 in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

## Organization
Rotaract South Asia MDIO (RSA MDIO)
Official organization site: https://rsamdio.org/

## Registration (delegates)
Official registration URL: https://go.rsamdio.org/ananta

## Venue (as stated on the site)
Ramada by Wyndham Bengaluru Yelahanka — Doddaballapur Road, Yelahanka, Bengaluru 560064, India
